title: Meeting prep
description: Before each upcoming call or meeting with someone outside the business, prepare a short brief: who they are, when the owner last met them, and their recent emails together

settings.HOURS_AHEAD: how far ahead to prepare briefs, in hours
settings.EMAILS_PER_PERSON: how many recent emails with each person go in the brief
settings.SKIP: addresses or domains that don't need a brief (colleagues, family)
